verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's Swarm tool orchestrates many sub-agents from a Code Mode script. It uses `Promise.all`-style fan-out with bounded concurrency, structured results and live progress, and sub-agents parallelize slow work, so batch work across many items is a documented first-party capability. However, it is framed as agent fan-out rather than a dedicated bulk-operation feature (e.g., select-many-and-apply), and its depth for item-level batch actions is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation semantics over item sets, documentation of item-level batch actions, and independent hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk runs.
